adaintum.name: Adiantum (Maidenhair Fern)
adaintum.description: A delicate and incredibly beautiful fern known for its feathery, light green foliage and distinct dark stems. It adds a soft, airy texture to any vertical garden composition.

alpenia.name: Alpinia (Ginger Lily)
alpenia.description: A striking tropical plant with lush, broad leaves and spectacular flowers. It provides bold structure and a dramatic flair, perfect for creating a dense jungle aesthetic.

areca.name: Areca Palm
areca.description: Known for its smooth, golden trunks and feathery fronds, the Areca Palm brings an instant tropical vibe. It is highly effective at purifying indoor air.

bird_nest.name: Bird's Nest Fern
bird_nest.description: Characterized by its large, apple-green, unbroken fronds that form a distinctive rosette. It thrives in the humid, shaded environments often found in vertical gardens.

black_lily.name: Black Lily
black_lily.description: An exotic and rare addition featuring striking, dark, almost black blooms. It creates a stunning visual contrast against bright green foliage.

brazil.name: Philodendron Brasil
brazil.description: A beautiful trailing plant with heart-shaped leaves painted with strokes of yellow and lime green. It cascades elegantly down vertical walls.

elk_horn.name: Elkhorn Fern
elk_horn.description: A fascinating epiphytic fern with unique fronds that resemble the antlers of an elk. It grows naturally on trees and is perfect for mounting on vertical structures.

giant.name: Giant Philodendron
giant.description: Featuring massive, glossy, deeply lobed leaves, this plant is a true showstopper. It creates an incredible sense of scale and lushness.

iris blue.name: Blue Iris
iris blue.description: Renowned for its spectacular, vividly colored flowers and slender, sword-like leaves. It adds a brilliant pop of color and vertical structure.

iris yello.name: Yellow Iris
iris yello.description: A radiant flowering plant that produces bright, cheerful yellow blooms. It brings energy and contrast to deeply shaded green walls.

kang.name: Kangaroo Paw Fern
kang.description: An incredibly hardy fern with leathery, uniquely shaped fronds. It creates dense, highly textured clusters that are incredibly resilient.

kerala.name: Tropical Kerala Plant
kerala.description: A vibrant, broad-leafed tropical species native to humid climates. It provides immense coverage and a rich, deep green backdrop.

kerala100.name: Tropical Kerala Plant
kerala100.description: A vibrant, broad-leafed tropical species native to humid climates. It provides immense coverage and a rich, deep green backdrop.

leuco.name: Leucojum
leuco.description: A delicate, graceful plant known for its charming, bell-shaped white flowers. It offers a soft, elegant touch to refined garden designs.

lily.name: Peace Lily
lily.description: Famous for its dark, glossy leaves and striking white floral spathes. It is one of the most effective plants for filtering indoor air toxins.

linea.name: Stromanthe Triostar
linea.description: A spectacular foliage plant featuring vibrant splashes of pink, cream, and green. It provides an immediate and dramatic burst of color.

littlephil.name: Philodendron 'Little Phil'
littlephil.description: A compact, highly adaptable philodendron variant that forms dense, bushy growth. It is perfect for filling in the lower canopies of a living wall.

maidenhair.name: Maidenhair Fern
maidenhair.description: A delicate and incredibly beautiful fern known for its feathery, light green foliage and distinct dark stems. It adds a soft, airy texture to any composition.

micans.name: Philodendron Micans
micans.description: A stunning vining plant with velvety, heart-shaped leaves that shimmer with a bronze-green hue. It adds an unparalleled texture and richness to the wall.

micro.name: Microsorum
micro.description: A robust, highly textured fern that spreads beautifully. Its intricate frond structures create dense, lush layers in a vertical arrangement.

microsorum-punctatum.name: Microsorum Punctatum
microsorum-punctatum.description: An incredibly tough fern with leathery, strap-like leaves. It is perfect for creating durable, long-lasting greenery in challenging environments.

monstera.name: Monstera Deliciosa
monstera.description: The iconic tropical plant famous for its large, heavily fenestrated leaves. It brings a powerful, architectural presence to any indoor jungle.

monstera_mini.name: Mini Monstera (Rhaphidophora)
monstera_mini.description: Resembling a miniature Monstera, this vigorous climber features beautifully split leaves. It scales vertical surfaces rapidly and elegantly.

nephro.name: Nephrolepis (Boston Fern)
nephro.description: A classic, elegant fern with gracefully arching fronds. It is highly effective at increasing ambient humidity and purifying the air.

oxygold.name: Philodendron 'Lemon Lime'
oxygold.description: A vibrant, neon-yellow trailing plant that cascades beautifully. It provides an incredibly striking contrast against darker, moody foliage.

oxygreen.name: Heartleaf Philodendron
oxygreen.description: A classic, incredibly resilient vining plant with glossy heart-shaped leaves. It is the perfect foundational plant for draping over vertical structures.

ped.name: Philodendron Pedatum
ped.description: A unique climbing aroid featuring deeply lobed, star-shaped leaves. It adds an exotic, almost alien-like architectural shape to the wall.

pedatum.name: Philodendron Pedatum
pedatum.description: A unique climbing aroid featuring deeply lobed, star-shaped leaves. It adds an exotic, almost alien-like architectural shape to the wall.

pendanas.name: Pandanus (Screw Pine)
pendanas.description: A striking tropical plant with long, strap-like leaves that arrange in a spiral. It adds a spiky, architectural texture to the garden.

perisoverde.name: Philodendron Paraiso Verde
perisoverde.description: A highly sought-after collector's plant featuring incredibly elongated leaves with stunning, mottled variegation. A true centerpiece.

philogiant.name: Philodendron Giganteum
philogiant.description: Featuring massive, glossy, deeply lobed leaves, this plant is a true showstopper. It creates an incredible sense of scale and lushness.

rabbit.name: Rabbit's Foot Fern
rabbit.description: A charming fern known for its furry, creeping rhizomes that resemble rabbit paws. It creates beautiful, textured ground cover on vertical surfaces.

ring.name: Philodendron 'Ring of Fire'
ring.description: An incredibly unique hybrid featuring serrated leaf edges and stunning variegation ranging from sunset orange to deep green.

selloum.name: Philodendron Selloum
selloum.description: A massive, tree-like philodendron with deeply divided, ruffled leaves. It brings an immense, prehistoric jungle energy to the installation.

subhstatum.name: Philodendron Subhastatum
subhstatum.description: A stunning, rare variety featuring glossy green tops and brilliant, blood-red undersides. It adds an incredible flash of color when viewed from below.

sword fern.name: Sword Fern
sword fern.description: A robust, deeply green fern with stiff, upright fronds. It is incredibly hardy and creates a powerful, structured baseline for vertical designs.
